name: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier
summary: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier is a rapid-drying, 2-component, water based epoxy resin that chemically cures to form a permanent hydrostatic barrier.
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier is a rapid-drying, 2-component, water based epoxy resin that chemically cures to form a permanent hydrostatic barrier.
attributes: Great penetration into porous construction materials
Rapid drying 1-3hrs @ 23°C dependant on substrate porosity
Highly fluid and easy to apply
Resist up to 4 bar negative water pressure - 2 Coat application
Suitable for use with underfloor heating
usage: Applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor
To stop rising moisture in concrete
To stop rising moisture on early aged concrete
Can be used under Sikafloor installation systems

packaging: 2.8kg part A & 1.4kg part B = 4.2kg kit (3.9L) 12kg part A & 6kg part B = 18kg kit (16.66L)

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text:
Water Vapour Transmission (ASTM E96)
CETEC Green Building Council requirement
Negative Hydrostatic Pressure - MTC test report

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier has a shelf life of 24 months from the date of production, if stored properly in undamaged, original, sealed packaging.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier should be stored in cool dry conditions at all times.
Protected from direct sunlight and keep at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C.
Do not allow Part A to freeze.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text:
In-situ probe test up to 100% RH
All testing/readings should conform with relevant AS/NZ standards

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Over-coating with a suitable Sika® - Non-porous primer, Adhesive or a second coat of Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier may be applied no sooner than 1+hours @ +23 °C. Note:
Drying is dependent on temperature, air flow & relative humidity and porosity of the substrate.
Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Smooth concrete surface | 4-6m2/L,
Smooth cement based compound | 4-6m2/L,
Mechanically profiled or very porous surface may require 2 coats | 4-6m2/L, on first coat 6-8m2/L on second coat
Consumption average is dependent on the absorbency of the substrate.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Low speed electric drill and mixing paddle required for 18kg kit
~10mm nap roller

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
4.2kg kit: Plug the component B upright on the component A can and wait until the component B is empty, then close the cap of the component A can. After combining component A and component B in the correct ratio, shake the can thoroughly. A minimum shaking time of 1 minute is required. Re-shake is required if the mixture appearance is still inhomogeneous.
18kg kit: Pour 12kg part A into 6kg part B (2:1) then mix with an electric drill and paddle (Paint Mixer Type) at a low speed to reduce air entrapment. Using a paint stick or similar is not sufficient to mix the product. A mixing time of 2-3 minutes shall be observed. Mixing shall continue until a homogeneous mix has been achieved. Scrape sides and bottom of pails to ensure all contents are thoroughly mixed together. Unmixed material applied to the floor will not cure properly.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Porous Surface Apply 1 coat of Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier to the substrate using a 10mm nap roller, ensuring that a continuous coat is achieved over the entire surface (MUST produce a wet reflective appearance-CLEAR). On particularly porous sections where the initial coat is absorbed immediately, re-apply immediately.
Application | Coat requirements
Substrate Primer | Minimum 1 Coat
Moisture Barrier for negative hydrostatic pressure applications | Minimum 2 coats
Note: Waiting time between coats is no sooner than 1+hrs.
Subsequent applications of Sikafloor Systems - Refer to relevant System Method Statement.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use.
